gaps.title: Tesla Cybercab turns 10-minute Austin trip into 70-minute detour — no highways, no railroad crossings
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Surface-street-only limitation combined with at-grade railroad-crossing avoidance forces massive detours across all Austin robotaxi vehicles (Cybercab + Model Y fleet). App shows price but not trip-time estimates, so riders discover the detour only mid-ride. Waymo already allows highway driving in some cities, underlining a competitive gap.

gaps.title: Tesla and SpaceX sue nanotechnology firm TERA-print to secure 'Terafab' trademark
gaps.whyItMightMatter: TERA-print sent a cease-and-desist over its existing 'Tera-Fab' mark; Tesla and SpaceX responded with a federal complaint in Austin. Legal cloud over the brand name adds friction to the $16.8B project's permitting and public communications track.

gaps.title: Tesla deploys first pre-assembled 1.2 MW Megachargers for Semi production ramp
gaps.whyItMightMatter: First factory-pre-assembled V4 Megacharger units (dual posts, 1.2 MW each) now in the field; invite-only Semi rollout at Sparks factory set for Sept 24. Charging infrastructure deployment is the critical bottleneck for fleet electrification ahead of Semi deliveries accelerating.

gaps.title: Tesla Roadster production reveal confirmed for October 1 in Waco, Texas
gaps.whyItMightMatter: First hard date for Roadster production reveal after nine years of delays; countdown timer live on Tesla website; reservation-holder invitations reference Waco TX venue and Sept 16 RSVP deadline. Marks transition from prototype to production reveal — but analysts note the SpaceX 'thruster package' framing may be tying Roadster timing to a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger narrative.

gaps.title: Tesla Roadster teaser hints at 'Cyber' redesign — full-width light bar and angular styling
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Weekend teaser suggests production Roadster inherits Cybertruck/Cybercab angular 'Cyber' aesthetic with full-width light bar, departing from the 2017 concept's curves. Electrek critical: original design had stronger appeal; changes risk alienating reservation holders who already waited 8+ years. SpaceX cold-gas thruster package headline feature.
